A friendly note about floor markings
It is for anyone travelling with a pet
Keep to the pet travel floor markings right away. They are there to guide you and to keep the path clear for every traveler and animal using Aurelia Skyways.

Please follow the marked route when you arrive at the terminal and when you move toward the Companion Animal Travel Desk. This helps the team check documents, carrier fit, and comfort needs without delay, and it helps avoid confusion for other travelers. If you are unsure where to stand, wait beside the nearest marking and ask the desk staff for help. They will answer in a warm, professional way and give you clear, kind guidance that is easy to act on.

We treat each journey as a shared responsibility, so small steps matter. A steady leash, a secure carrier, and close attention to the floor markings make the process smoother for you, your pet, and everyone nearby. If you need support, please come straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, and we will help you move forward with care.
